There is an election next month.
Citizens have the right to vote.
Freedom of expression is a basic right.

title.ko: 정치 어휘 · 법과 시민 · 의무와 권리 · 보도 수동태
title.en: political vocabulary · law and citizens · rights and duties · reporting passives

explain.ko: 정치와 법에 관한 글에서는 제도, 권리와 의무, 사건의 진행을 객관적으로 서술합니다. 어휘는 government, parliament, bill, election, right, duty, court, ruling입니다. 권리는 have the right to + 동사, 의무는 have a duty to / be obliged to + 동사로 말합니다. 보도 문체에서는 보도 수동태(It is said that …, … is reported to have …)와 be due to + 동사(~할 예정이다)를 많이 사용합니다. 정치적 주제는 사실과 의견을 구분하고 중립적인 어조를 유지합니다.
explain.en: Writing about politics and law describes institutions, rights and duties and events objectively. Vocabulary: government, parliament, bill, election, right, duty, court, ruling. Rights: have the right to + verb; duties: have a duty to / be obliged to + verb. News style uses reporting passives (It is said that …, … is reported to have …) and be due to + verb for scheduled events. Separate facts from opinions and keep a neutral tone.

task.model: Citizens have the right to vote and freedom of expression. At the same time they have a duty to pay taxes and obey the law. Those who violate the law are tried in court. Everyone is equal before the law.

model_trans.ko: 시민은 투표할 권리와 표현의 자유를 가집니다. 동시에 세금을 내고 법을 지킬 의무가 있습니다. 법을 위반한 사람은 법원에서 재판을 받습니다. 법 앞에서는 모두가 평등합니다.
model_trans.en: Citizens have the right to vote and freedom of expression. At the same time they have a duty to pay taxes and obey the law. Those who violate the law are tried in court. Everyone is equal before the law.
